text:
The response offers only generic, high-level advice (e.g., “sit down and talk,” “communicate honestly,” “seek professional help”) without any specific communication techniques, structured exercises, or questions to understand the couple’s unique dynamics. It lacks depth, actionable strategies, and the personalized approach expected from a relationship coach. While the suggestions are not incorrect, they are too vague to be genuinely helpful for resolving real conflicts.

Rating: [[3]]
